integrity: The proof is analytic; numeric root estimates and a standard-library reproduction checker supplement but do not replace it. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification only for the real normal three-dimensional circulant family and the standard coordinatewise cone; one original 3x3 rotation-decay example and general eventual-positivity theory are prior art. Numerical testing is finite; scholarly priority is not independently established.
title: A sharp positivity-time staircase for three-state circulant semigroups
